description: Saves an anchored image in several formats.

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description: CSS selector of the image or exportable component.

events.name: tp-save-image-error
events.description: Emitted when the target cannot be exported.

events.description: Emitted after an image has been prepared for download.
events.detail: { format: "svg" | "png" | "webp"; filename: string; anchor: string; target: Element }

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-save-image>` element implements the <tp-icon name="save-image" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Save image functionality: saves an anchored image in several formats.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Save image button | Download the associated image. The browser handles the download. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between the available controls. |
| Enter / Space | Activate the focused button. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |
